name: Killing Insects
overview: Scripture reveals that God has granted mankind dominion over all creatures, including insects, as seen in Genesis 1:26. Insects are often described as unclean or abominable in the Law (Leviticus 11:20; Deuteronomy 14:19), underscoring their distinct place in creation. The Bible also portrays God’s authority over insects, using them symbolically to demonstrate His power to protect and judge (Psalms 118:12; Isaiah 7:18; Isaiah 40:22). Thus, killing insects aligns with exercising God-given dominion within the framework of His sovereign design.
